@@U00043@@
Your works sublime survive forever As bright as on the primal day.

@@U00045@@
(Entering.)

@@U00046@@
Lord, since you approach us once again, and ask how we're getting on; and since in the past I’ve never been made feel unwelcome, I present myself once more among your servants. Youll forgive me, I know, if | make no pretty speeches, but, you see, I’m just not very good at it, not even if I’m scoffed at and scorned. I'd make you laugh, I know, with my sorry pathos— except that you gave up laughter eons ago. I mean, really, what can I say about your sun and your worlds? Nothing; nothing at all. All I see is how men torment themselves. And as for that little lord of creation, he’s no less “wondrous” than on the day you made him. And yet, I'd say, he might be better off if you hadn't blessed him with that glimpse of heavenly light that he calls Reason, and which he uses to make himself more beastly than any beast. You'll pardon my saying so, but to me he resembles more the long-legged cricket that does nothing but leap about, higher and higher, only to end up back where he began, deep in the grass singing the same old song. If only he'd stay in the grass! But he pokes his nose into every kind of filth.

@@U00048@@
Is that all you've come to say? Do you always come here only to accuse me? Is there nothing on earth that ever pleases you?
translation:
@@U00043@@
你的作品崇高而永远存在，像原始的日子一样明亮。

@@U00045@@
（进入。）

@@U00046@@
主啊，既然你再次走近我们，询问我们过得怎么样；由于过去我从未感到不受欢迎，所以我再次出现在您的仆人之中。我知道，如果|你会原谅我的不会发表漂亮的演讲，但是，你看，我只是不太擅长，即使我被嘲笑和蔑视。我知道，我会让你发笑，带着我抱歉的悲伤——只不过你很久以前就不再笑了。我的意思是，真的，关于你的太阳和你的世界我能说些什么呢？没有什么;什么都没有。我看到的只是男人如何折磨自己。至于那个小造物主，他并不比你创造他那天更“奇妙”。然而，我想说，如果你没有祝福他瞥见他称之为理性的天堂之光，他可能会过得更好，他用理性使自己变得比任何野兽都更野兽。请原谅我这么说，但对我来说，他更像是一只长腿蟋蟀，除了跳来跳去之外什么也不做，越来越高，最后又回到了他开始的地方，在草丛深处唱着同样的老歌。要是他能留在草丛就好了！但他却把鼻子伸进各种污秽之中。

@@U00048@@
你来就是为了说这些吗？你来这里只是为了指责我吗？世上没有什么能让你高兴的事吗？
